sequencing_rules.rule: Introduce new DTO fields only after updating schemas in tmp/, pydantic models, backend validators, telemetry, and adapters together.
Frontend may switch to DayBrief/WeekBrief only once backend returns validated payloads plus legacy adapters.
LLM prompt changes must ship with deterministic fallback templates and logging updates.
Slow background factors (progressions/solar/profection) must be computed before WeekBrief reads them; do not stub them on frontend.

deferred_work.item: GA-quality feedback loop for DayBrief/WeekBrief confidence calibration.

Per-domain reaction logging on frontend to tune action/risk weights.
Extraction of DTO schemas into shared package for CI validation.
